comparison: Compared under protocol seed 0 and deterministic_orthogonal initialization against bispf-v1 and the BCAP DualNorm leader, bispf-v2 retains 100% of Tier 1 passes (22/22 across views) and 100% of required Tier 2 baseline passes while successfully completing Tier 3 endurance qualification with 0 hold or extension failures.
conclusion: Born-Infeld Sinkhorn Particle Flow v2 (BISPF v2, bispf-v2) achieves full qualification through Tier 3: passing 7/7 Tier 1 tasks (100% across all 6 views), 10/10 required Tier 2 baseline tasks with 0 regressions, and Tier 3 endurance qualification with ring_hold (1200/1200 checks, 0 failures) and ring_extension (300/300 checks, 0 failures) PASS. Recomputed complete live curves and terminal suffixes confirm stability under direct thermal hook scaling, SBNP covariance tethering, and late-training harmonic mode capture.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: BISPF v2 repairs at least 6/11 Tier 2 failures on discriminator_stability reaching >= 16/21 passes while preserving all 7 Tier 1 passes (22/22 across views) and all 10 passing Tier 2 tasks with 0 regressions.
next_action: Promote bispf-v2 to repository-wide default selection in family-current-v1.json, refresh publication records, and compile final memory.

study.competing_explanation: If within-basin step scaling or anisotropic covariance adaptation disturbs the zero-mean gauge or SBNP tethering, mode_hold or five_word_joint_hold will regress.
